newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Richter hits new high on mkt confidence.
newsitem.headline: Richter hits new high on mkt confidence.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Rt jumped to uncharted levels on Wednesday, reflecting continuous investor confidence in the company, traders said.
Richter shares firmed to a new record high of 15,250 forints before giving up a little. At 1033 GMT Richter shares traded at 15,200 forints, up 205 from Tuesday's close.
"This rise could be expected when results of its private placement came through the market," one trader said.

Earlier this month a total of 2.6 million Richter shares, including one million newly issued stocks, were offered privately to institutional investors at $78 and 14,160 forints, a price which was hardly below the then prevailing market price. The shares on offer were oversubscribed by 4.5 times.
An additional 200,000 shares can currently be subscribed by domestic investors.
